title: 会計情報とビジネス法規
subtitle: Accounting Information and Business Regulations
teachers:
KITAGAWA Tatsuya
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning and educational goal of the Department of Management Systems. The goal is for the student to understand important accounting standards to understand what accounting information conveys and to understand the basic part of legal knowledge such as tax system, corporate law, civil law, etc. as peripheral knowledge so that they can understand the contents of securities report, which is a general disclosure document of a company.
advice:
This course covers a wide range of subjects such as accounting standards, taxation, and legal knowledge related to corporate law.
First of all, since this course will be conducted on the premise that you understand the matters learned in the "Accounting basic", it is necessary to review the "Accounting basic".
In addition, new terms and ideas will appear frequently, so enthusiastic class participation and constant efforts are required.
requiredKnowledge: Since this course teaches the theoretical part of accounting, it is necessary to have a solid understanding of what was learned in "Accounting Basic" in order to understand the content of the lesson.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the concept of important accounting standards.
Be able to understand what accounting information conveys by understanding accounting standards.
Be able to understand the overall mechanism of the tax system centered on corporate tax and income tax.
Be able to use your tax knowledge for business and life by understanding the overall mechanism of the tax system
Be able to recognize the importance of legal knowledge in conducting corporate management.
Be able to understand the minimum required legal knowledge about corporate management.

              This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning and educational goal of the Department of Management Systems. The goal is for the student to understand important accounting standards to understand what accounting information conveys and to understand the basic part of legal knowledge such as tax system, corporate law, civil law, etc. as peripheral knowledge so that they can understand the contents of securities report, which is a general disclosure document of a company.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course covers a wide range of subjects such as accounting standards, taxation, and legal knowledge related to corporate law.
First of all, since this course will be conducted on the premise that you understand the matters learned in the "Accounting basic", it is necessary to review the "Accounting basic".
In addition, new terms and ideas will appear frequently, so enthusiastic class participation and constant efforts are required.
